systems.system: Gabon Connect (eTax, eEmployeur, TresorPay, eDouane, ePropriete)

GAB.note: Portals are presented as a rollout to December 2027; no core finance, tax or payroll system is stated in use.

facts.fact: Vice-president of the government Hermann Immongault presented the Gabon Connect single digital window on 22 October 2026, with the Declaration unique des salaires and TresorPay portals deployed in a phase due to finish in December 2027.

systems.tiers: tax, employer formalities, non-tax revenue, customs, land registry

GAB.note: No register keyed on the national ID number is stated.
No check against the national ID is stated.
Says nothing of who builds or runs the systems.
